serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Oh no…
Landlord: Hey, You maggot! If you got the money for prostitutes you should also have money to pay more for rent. Ain’t that right?
This guy showed up at the worst time...
'Nun' Shanice: As I said before, I’m not a prostitute!
Landlord: Yeah yeah, I know. Now you are called ‘sex workers’. 
Landlord: Sorry hun, I’m not into that new speech of yours. 
'Nun' Shanice: What the fuck are you even talking about!
Landlord: You should calm down, you know? You are ‘turning off’ potential clients right now hehe. I don’t like when they talk too much.
Uff, I don’t know how to de-escalate this conversation… 
'Nun' Shanice: I’m not doing anything for money here! You should apologise!
Landlord: Not for money?! {{wi}}W-well…
Landlord: I will not apologise, but I do feel sorry about your taste in men.
'Nun' Shanice: Wha?!
Landlord: I will get going now, my mood got worse, because of you…
'Nun' Shanice: Good!
Landlord: And as for you Anon… {{wi}}Remember to pay up.
